We need to determine crimes based on facts: illegal fishing in a prohibited area using prohibited gear, capture of fish, illegal profit. Chinese criminal law: "非法捕捞水产资源罪" (illegal fishing of aquatic resources) under Article 338 of Criminal Law. Also possibly "非法捕捞、捕捞渔业资源罪" (illegal fishing). Also "走私、非法买卖、运输、携带、收购、使用禁用渔具罪"? Actually there is a specific offense: "非法捕捞水产资源罪" (illegal fishing). Also "非法使用禁用渔具罪"? Chinese law has "非法捕捞、捕捞水产资源罪" and "非法使用禁用渔具罪" maybe under Article 338. Let's recall: Criminal Law Article 338: "非法捕捞、捕捞水产资源，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金或者没收财产。" Also "非法使用、买卖、运输、携带、提供禁用渔具" is also covered? Actually there is separate provision: "非法捕捞、捕捞水产资源罪" includes using prohibited gear. So one crime.

Also maybe "非法捕捞、捕捞水产资源罪" is the only one. Could also be "走私、非法买卖、运输、携带、收购、使用禁用渔具罪" under Article 338? Not sure. The facts: using prohibited net (minimum mesh 9mm) in a prohibited area. That is illegal fishing. So the crime: "非法捕捞水产资源罪". Also maybe "非法捕捞、捕捞水产资源罪" is the same.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法捕捞水产资源罪<eoa>
